caseName: United States Surgical Corp. v. Ethicon, Inc.
caseNameFull: United States Surgical Corp. v. Ethicon, Inc.

opinions.text:
C. A. Fed. Cir. Certiorari granted, judgment vacated, and case remanded for further consideration in light of Markman v. Westview Instruments, Inc., ante, p. 370.

Justice Breyer took no part in the consideration or decision of this case.
